description: Claude usage widget for Windows 10 and 11: a small desktop widget that shows your Claude Code 5-hour limit and weekly limit with traffic-light bars and reset countdowns. Rate limit monitor in PowerShell, no install, no admin rights.
release_notes:
Support for accounts without a 5-hour limit.

- When the API reports no 5-hour limit for your account, the widget shows the weekly bar alone in a smaller card. It goes back to two bars if the API reports the limit again. Before this release the 5-hour row stayed on screen with "no data".
- A null value from the API or in the local cache no longer shows as a 0% row.

To update: right-click the widget, choose Close widget, replace the files in its folder with the ones from this ZIP, then run `install.bat`.

New install: unzip anywhere, run `install.bat`. Needs Claude Code signed in with a Claude subscription account such as Pro or Max.
